newsitem.title: USA: GTS Duratek sets $5.9 million reserve.
newsitem.headline: GTS Duratek sets $5.9 million reserve.

text.p: GTS Duratek said Wednesday it expected to take a reserve of $5.9 million to replace the melter box at its M-Area processing plant on the Department of Energy's Savannah River Site and to cover its losses on a fixed price contract at the site.

The environmental technology company predicted the facility would resume radioactive waste processing by the end of the year, adding it is seeking to extend the date by which it was to complete waste processing under the contract.

The company also said its DuraChem facility in Barnwell, S.C., would not begin commercial operation this year as previously reported, citing new priorities established with the closing of the Scientific Ecology Group purchase from Westinghouse Electric Corp.
GTS said it is completing the final actions necessary to close the acquisition, which will add 14 field deployed technologies and 700 employees to its operation.
